meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症细胞系的基因依赖性与药物敏感性,锁定肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在做肿瘤靶点发现或验证,需要查细胞系基因依赖性数据
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer cell line gene dependencies and drug sensitivity to pinpoint tumor targets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study oncology targets and need cell line dependency data

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能查询 DepMap 的癌细胞系基因依赖性评分(CRISPR Chronos)、药物敏感性和基因效应谱,用来找癌症特异弱点、合成致死配对,以及验证肿瘤药靶点。
howto.when: 当你要求验证某基因是否为特定癌症的必需基因、寻找合成致死配对,或查询化合物敏感性时触发。

say.text: KRAS 在肺癌细胞系里是不是必需基因?
say.note: 会返回 Chronos 依赖评分并筛出依赖细胞系

say.text: 找出 BRCA1 突变细胞系里的合成致死基因
say.note: 对比突变型与野生型细胞系的基因效应分数

say.text: 这个基因是全癌种必需还是选择性必需?
say.note: 比较各癌种细胞系的依赖分数分布

howto.what_en: Installs DepMap querying: Claude looks up cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity, and gene effect profiles to find cancer-selective dependencies, synthetic lethal pairs, and validate oncology targets.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask whether a gene is essential in a given cancer type, want synthetic lethal partners, or query drug sensitivity.

say_en.text: Is KRAS essential across lung cancer cell lines?
say_en.note: Returns Chronos dependency scores and dependent lines

say_en.text: Find synthetic lethal partners in BRCA1-mutant cell lines
say_en.note: Compares gene effect in mutant vs wild-type lines

say_en.text: Is this gene pan-essential or cancer-selective?
say_en.note: Compares dependency score spread across cancer types
